list.name: project
list.label: Project
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT project FROM runs WHERE project IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1;

targets.rawSql: SELECT time_bucket('1 day', COALESCE(finished_at, started_at)) AS time, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN status='succeeded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/NULLIF(COUNT(*),0), 1) AS success_rate FROM runs WHERE $__timeFilter(COALESCE(finished_at, started_at)) AND (CASE WHEN COALESCE('${project:csv}','') = '' THEN TRUE ELSE project IN (${project:csv}) END) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time;

SELECT time_bucket('1 day', COALESCE(finished_at, started_at)) AS time, ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (finished_at - started_at)))/60.0, 1) AS avg_min FROM runs WHERE $__timeFilter(COALESCE(finished_at, started_at)) AND finished_at IS NOT NULL AND started_at IS NOT NULL AND (CASE WHEN COALESCE('${project:csv}','') = '' THEN TRUE ELSE project IN (${project:csv}) END) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time;

SELECT COALESCE(project,'Unknown') AS project, ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (finished_at - started_at))/60.0), 1) AS avg_min FROM runs WHERE finished_at IS NOT NULL AND started_at IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(finished_at, started_at) >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' GROUP BY COALESCE(project,'Unknown') ORDER BY avg_min DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;
